text: Swimming involves laps and goggles. Laps help in maintaining a consistent pace, while goggles provide protection from the sun and other water hazards. Swimming laps can vary in length, from short to long, depending on the fitness level and the type of pool being used. Some pools offer lap machines, which help to regulate the speed of the swimmer. Swimming goggles are worn by swimmers to prevent injury and to protect the eyes from the sun.
